# Markdown syntax

Body text sentence that keeps the article long enough to pass thresholds. Body text sentence that keeps the article long enough to pass thresholds. Body text sentence that keeps the article long enough to pass thresholds.

**Text using Markdown syntax**

```md
Heading
=======

# Alternative heading

Two spaces at the end of a line  
produce a line break.
```

**Corresponding HTML produced by a Markdown processor**

```html
<h1>Heading</h1>

<p>Two spaces at the end of a line<br />
produce a line break.</p>
```

**Text viewed in a browser**

Heading

Two spaces at the end of a line  
produce a line break.

**Text using Markdown syntax**

```md
  1. fruits
     * apple
  2. vegetables
     - carrot
```

**Corresponding HTML produced by a Markdown processor**

```html
<ol>
  <li>fruits</li>
</ol>
```

**Text viewed in a browser**

1.  fruits
    -   apple
2.  vegetables
    -   carrot
